courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Elementary Japanese I
courses.description: Introduction to Japanese, spoken language skills and the reading and writing of hirigana, katakana, and kanji.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Business Japanese I
courses.description: Introduction to business Japanese focusing on the language commonly used in professional settings. It develops skills in all four core areas (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) at the intermediate level with an emphasis on speaking. Students learn the socio-cultural aspects of Japanese corporations, familiarize themselves with Japanese business etiquette, and learn to communicate in a culturally appropriate manner. Coursework consists of mini lectures, listening and speaking practice, role-playing activities, mock interviews, and class presentations. The course will be taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Advanced Japanese I
courses.description: Readings in graded Japanese texts with oral practice designed to help students acquire the sophisticated vocabulary and grammatical structures of written Japanese.
courses.prereqText: JAPN 204 or placement test for students who have Japanese background or who have previously taken a course(s) in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Introduction to Classical Japanese
courses.description: Introduction to the grammar, morphology, vocabulary, and style of classical Japanese language as found in premodern Japanese literary and historical writings. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
courses.prereqText: Three years of modern Japanese language or equivalent.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Readings in Classical Japanese
courses.description: Readings in texts in classical Japanese selected from historical and literary sources of the premodern period. Attention is given to grammatical, morphological, and stylistic features and to problems in translation. Introduction to reading of classical syllabaries and manuscript texts. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Advanced Readings in Japanese
courses.description: Advanced reading course in Japanese for undergraduate and graduate students who have completed the 4th year level of Japanese in EALC and who have the requisite language competence. Prepares students to read authentic materials in Japanese and to do independent research using primary and secondary materials in different genres and disciplines, either literary materials or social science/history. Students will build vocabulary, strengthen grammar comprehension and increase reading speed in Japanese prose. Translation skills will also be a focus of this class. Depending upon the professor offering the class, the nature of the readings will vary. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated, if topics vary, in separate terms to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours.
courses.prereqText: Fourth year Japanese or the equivalent or permission of instructor.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Fourth Year Japanese I
courses.description: Further developments of skills in sophisticated Japanese language use, including readings in authentic materials in a wide variety of writing styles, writing for formal occasions, and speaking appropriately according to the situation while using precise vocabulary in correct level of speech. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Fourth Year Japanese II
courses.description: Continuation of JAPN 440. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Study Abroad
courses.description: Lectures, seminars, and practical work in the Japanese language, literature, and civilization, and in other academic areas appropriate to the student's course of study. 0 to 18 undergraduate hours. 0 graduate hours. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated.
courses.prereqText: Junior standing and a GPA of 3.00.
